cohort: Pregnant women who were admitted to the Dept. of Obstetrics and Gynaecology of Dr. D.Y. Patil Hospital and Research Institute, Kolhapur, Maharashtra during the second wave of the COVID-19 pandemic.
finding: The study found a high incidence of maternal complications like anemia and fetal complications including low birth weight, IUGR, fetal distress, abortions, preterm birth, and intrauterine deaths among pregnant women admitted during the COVID-19 pandemic, which was associated with increased psychological stress and scarcity of services.
mod_finding: Emergency LSCS was performed in 68% of patients, normal vaginal delivery in 29.3%, and intra-uterine death occurred in 2.7% of cases.
cross-section timing: During the second wave of the COVID-19 pandemic
